review_candidates.description: CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com. What You’ll Do The Storage Engine Team at CoreWeave is responsible for the product capabilities and data plane function of CoreWeave’s managed storage products. We build reliable, scalable storage solutions with segment leading performance. Storage engine works with engineering teams across infrastructure, compute, and platform to ensure our storage services meet the needs of the world’s most demanding AI workloads. About The Role Design and Implement distributed storage solutions to support scaling data intensive AI workloads. Contribute to the development of exabyte-scale, S3-compatible object storage and integrate dedicated storage clusters into diverse customer environments. Work with technologies such as RDMA, GPU Direct Storage, and distributed filesystems protocols such as NFS or FUSE to optimize storage performance and efficiency. Lead efforts to improve the reliability, durability, security, and observability of our storage stack. Collaborate with operations teams to monitor, troubleshoot, and improve storage systems in production environments. Set the bar for developing metrics and dashboards to provide visibility into storage performance and health. Analyze telemetry and system data to drive improvements in throughput, latency, and resilience. Work cross-functionally with platform, product, and infrastructure teams to deliver seamless storage capabilities across the stack. Share your knowledge and mentor other engineers on best practices in building distributed, high-performance systems. Who You Are Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 8–10+ years of experience working in storage systems engineering or infrastructure. Strong hands-on experience with object storage or distributed filesystems in production environments. Experience with one or more storage protocols (e.g. S3, NFS) and file systems such as Ceph, DAOS, or similar. Proficiency in a systems programming language such as Go, C, or Rust. Proficiency leveraging AI tools to augment software development. Familiarity with storage observability tools and telemetry pipelines (e.g., ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana). Experience working with cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, and scalable system architectures. Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Why CoreWeave? About At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: Be Curious at Your Core Act Like an Owner Empower Employees Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences Achieve More Together We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! The base salary range for this role is $188,000 to $275,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility). What We Offer The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) , CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. review_candidates.title: Sr. Analyst, Brand and Product Marketing
review_candidates.description: Journey with us! Combine your career goals and sense of adventure by joining our exciting team of employees. Royal Caribbean Group is pleased to offer a competitive compensation & benefits package, and excellent career development opportunities, each offering unique ways to explore the world. About The Company Silversea is the defining name in luxurious cruise travel by distinguishing itself in the ultra-luxury market with its elegant, all-suite ships, all-inclusive pricing, worldwide itineraries and genuine hospitality. All our ships feature spacious, ocean-view suites with butler service, and most include private verandas, meaning you can sip your champagne from the comfort of your deck while watching the vistas beyond. Whether you want to gaze at icebergs or palm trees, the choice is yours. Our ships sail pole-to-pole to over 900 destinations on all seven continents, leaving (almost) no part of coastline uncovered. We are proud of our reputation as the "World's Best" cruise line and seek individuals who take personal pride in their work to join our award-winning team. Role Overview The Senior Analyst, Brand and Product Marketing (Partnerships) supports the planning, activation, coordination, and performance measurement of Silversea's global brand partnerships portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Director, Brand Partnerships, this role plays a critical part in executing partnership initiatives that support awareness, guest engagement, acquisition, loyalty, and broader brand and commercial objectives. Working closely with the Senior Director and cross-functional stakeholders, the Senior Analyst helps translate partnership strategies into actionable activation plans, experiences, content programs, events, and guest-facing initiatives. The role is responsible for managing day-to-day partnership operations, activation timelines, partner deliverables, reporting, budget tracking, and stakeholder coordination to ensure seamless execution and exceptional brand experiences. This position requires strong project management, organizational, analytical, and relationship management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across a diverse portfolio of luxury, lifestyle, travel, hospitality, cultural, culinary, and experiential partners. The Senior Analyst contributes to partnership planning through research, performance analysis, and activation support while helping ensure partnerships deliver measurable results aligned to business objectives and brand standards. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Support the execution of Silversea's global brand partnerships portfolio across awareness, engagement, acquisition, loyalty, and guest experience initiatives. Assist in translating partnership strategies into activation plans, event concepts, content opportunities, guest experiences, and partner deliverables. Manage day-to-day coordination of partnership activations across Marketing, Communications, Events, Digital, Social Media, PR, Sales, Guest Experience, onboard teams, agencies, and external partners. Track activation timelines, project plans, contractual commitments, approval processes, and key milestones to ensure successful delivery. Coordinate partnership assets, deliverables, creative reviews, hospitality elements, guest touchpoints, and partner visibility requirements. Support the planning and execution of sponsorship activations, hosted experiences, events, and guest-facing programs. Maintain partnership calendars, activation schedules, documentation, scorecards, and relationship records. Support the operational management of a portfolio of luxury, lifestyle, travel, hospitality, culinary, cultural, wellness, and experiential partnerships. Assist in managing day-to-day communications with partners, agencies, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Ensure all partnership activities are executed consistently with Silversea's luxury brand standards and guest experience expectations. Partner closely with internal teams to ensure activations are integrated across owned, earned, paid, experiential, onboard, and digital channels. Conduct research on market trends, competitor partnerships, consumer insights, and emerging opportunities to support partnership planning and decision-making. Support the development of partnership performance reports, scorecards, recap presentations, ROI analyses, and executive updates. Track partnership KPIs and activation results, helping identify successes, lessons learned, and optimization opportunities. Maintain reporting dashboards and assist with performance measurement against defined business objectives and partnership goals. Analyze activation outcomes and provide recommendations to improve future partnership effectiveness and guest engagement. Monitor partnership budgets, purchase orders, invoices, reconciliation processes, and spend tracking. Assist with contract administration, documentation management, legal review coordination, and compliance requirements. Support budget forecasting and financial reporting processes for partnership initiatives. Maintain organized records of partner agreements, activation plans, reporting materials, and performance results. Support the Senior Director, Brand Partnerships in developing presentations, business cases, partner evaluations, and strategic planning materials. Contribute ideas and recommendations for new partnership activations, creative concepts, guest experiences, and engagement opportunities. Assist in the development of partnership roadmaps and annual planning processes through research, reporting, and project coordination. Support strategic marketing initiatives and other projects as assigned. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Hospitality, Event Management, or a related field. Experience & Essential Qualifications And Skills 4–6 years of experience in brand partnerships, sponsorships, events, experiential marketing, hospitality, luxury marketing, communications, or a related field. Experience supporting partnership activations, sponsorship programs, events, guest experiences, or strategic collaborations. Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience coordinating agencies, vendors, partners, and cross-functional business teams. Familiarity with partnership marketing, sponsorship activation, brand collaborations, and experiential programs. Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather, interpret, and present performance data and insights. Experience preparing presentations, reports, partnership recaps, and executive-ready materials. Understanding of KPI tracking, reporting frameworks, performance measurement, and ROI analysis. Strong communication and relationship-management skills with the ability to effectively collaborate across internal and external stakeholder groups. Understanding of luxury consumer expectations, hospitality, premium guest experiences, and brand standards. Financial literacy, including budget management, invoice processing, reconciliation, and expense tracking. Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and reporting tools. Strong digital and marketing acumen, including familiarity with social, content, CRM, and experiential marketing channels. Proactive, curious, and solutions-oriented mindset with a willingness to contribute both strategically and operationally. Fluency in English required; additional languages are a plus. Financial/Quantitive Responsibilities Supports tracking of partnership budgets, activation costs, invoices, financial reconciliation, and spend against approved budget. Supports ROI analysis, performance tracking, scorecard development, and post-activation reporting to evaluate partnership effectiveness and inform future investment decisions.

Manage the complete lifecycle of validated equipment and systems, including planning, execution, review, approval, periodic review, change control, and documentation retention. Review and approve qualification and validation protocols, reports, and related documentation prior to equipment/system release. Establish and maintain an effective calibration program in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable standards. Ensure calibration and validation activities are performed in compliance with approved procedures, EU-GMP, cGMP, and applicable ISO standards. Ensure appropriate environmental monitoring and control measures are implemented for cleanrooms in accordance with EU-GMP requirements. Oversee validation activities related to sterilization, temperature mapping, cold chain, container closure systems, media fills/aseptic process simulation, and environmental monitoring. Ensure appropriate implementation of Computerized System Validation (CSV) / Computer Software Assurance (CSA) requirements.
